summary: New Jersey's forest fire service opened a lookout on a Navy hangar at Lakehurst in 1922; the registry says its cab remains, and the site is now a restricted military area.

facts.design: 7x7-foot standard metal cab on a 6-foot tower atop a hangar roof
facts.status_note: Registry says the cab remains in place on the roof; no recent photo or inspection was found

access.note: Navy-administered military site that the registry calls a classified area; the public is unlikely to visit

facts.agency: U.S. Navy (Naval Air Station Lakehurst); opened by the New Jersey state forest fire service in 1922

events.note: Registry gives 1922 as the build year; June 1922 papers say it had just opened; a state report says it went into operation in fall 1922
March 1922 notice said a watchman would soon be stationed there; no named observer found
Registry says the observer would have witnessed the Hindenburg explosion; no source says anyone did. The Hindenburg burned at NAS Lakehurst on May 6, 1937

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The registry gives 1922 as the build year; June 1922 papers say the tower had just opened; the state's 1922-23 report says it went into operation in the fall of 1922. We use 1922 without a month.

The registry says the hangar is 95 feet tall; 1922 papers put the roof more than 200 feet above the surface; the Navy society gives Hangar No. One's doors as 177 feet tall. The sources do not name the hangar with the lookout, so we report the registry figure as doubtful rather than replacing it.

notes_for_editor: The 1922 opening and the registry's 1922 build year agree on the year; the month is unclear. The registry's 95-foot hangar height conflicts with the 1922 press and is not resolved; the sources never name the hangar. The Navy society's door height is for Hangar No. One, which the lookout's hangar may or may not be. The NJ Forest Fire Service Facebook post cited in searches could not be read, so it is not used. No staffing end year is given beyond 'after World War II'. No photo was found with a usable license. Current condition is unverified beyond the registry.
